summary.prose: Build a strict internal review subject from approved work and explicitly attributed commit packets, with bounded navigation of pinned source. Reuse existing canonicalization and hardened Git helpers. Keep the current review engine and MCP protocols unchanged until later integration.

tasks.title: Define immutable subject and foundational runtime contracts
tasks.summary: Add exact sc1/sc6 types and typed preparation inputs/errors under investigation/types.ts. Define trusted artifact/build-scope dependencies and limits without implementing later-story stores. Reuse existing canonical JSON and hashing directly.
acceptanceChecks: Export all HLD sc1/sc6 fields, including object|string staging and nullable usage counters; no imports from later Story implementations.
Preparation inputs distinguish trusted snapshot/provenance dependencies from untrusted selectors; named error causes remain explicit.
Canonical hash projection and recursive defensive freezing use existing canonicalJson/hashCanonical with explicit limits; reject invalid values.
Targeted tests for this task pass before advancing; final task adds cross-module regression coverage.

tests.name: sc1/sc6 canonical identity, invalid value and type contract fixtures

tasks.title: Extract exact parent-relative Git packets using existing hardened readers
tasks.summary: Add git-packets.ts over existing createGitRunner; minimally export decodeObject/treeEntry from corpus Git reader without changing behavior. Resolve full commits/actual selected parents, raw metadata and canonical text/non-text blocks with blob provenance.
acceptanceChecks: No HEAD/worktree/range diff selects scope; selected parent is direct parent and every referenced object is verified.
Represent add/delete/rename-with-edit/binary/mode and one-based inclusive ranges, including null zero-line side; preserve successive edits/reverts.
NUL-safe paths, no external diff/textconv/replacement refs/network/shell, bounded argv-only processes through existing runner.
Root commits/submodules/unsupported objects/limits produce explicit refusal; no silent truncation or fallback.
Targeted tests for this task pass before advancing; final task adds cross-module regression coverage.

tests.name: Exact parent/blob/change-kind packet and hardened reader reuse fixtures

tasks.title: Prepare subjects from approved work and trusted block attribution
tasks.summary: Add subject.ts to validate root/story/build/artifact bindings, project exact PLAN tasks/checks or legitimate approved upstream basis, verify each selected block against trusted scope records and compute stable immutable subject identity.
acceptanceChecks: All four Story AC obligations are represented: matching mode-independent packets, complete tasks/checks, explicit planless basis and revalidated freshness.
Caller evidence strings or Story trailer alone cannot attest exclusive block ownership; mixed/forged/overlapping/ambiguous selectors refuse admission.
Unapproved/stale/corrupt existing PLAN never becomes planless; BUILD need not be approved but source and membership must match trusted scope.
ContextTree binds explicit build sourceCommit; subject/packet/block identity stable and digest-sensitive; recheck input pins before returning.
Targeted tests for this task pass before advancing; final task adds cross-module regression coverage.

tests.name: Approved task projection, trusted attribution and freshness fixtures

tasks.title: Add bounded pinned source navigation and freshness guards
tasks.summary: Add source.ts and internal exports. Read only subject-bound blob/context-tree or approved immutable snapshot references using existing reader helpers; distinguish complete/partial/unavailable. Add assertReviewSubjectFresh against the original pins.
acceptanceChecks: Foreign HEAD/worktree/symlink content cannot alter pinned source or widen changed scope; context-only reads stay contextual.
Validate reference allowlist/ranges and resource caps; partial/unavailable have explicit limitations, source digest and requested range.
Contract revision/digest/source binding mismatch refuses stale subject without treating unrelated HEAD movement as changed scope.
No runtime ledger/store/accounting backend, MCP registration or engine activation.
Targeted tests for this task pass before advancing; final task adds cross-module regression coverage.

tests.name: Bounded immutable source navigation and reference isolation fixtures

tasks.title: Prove packet isolation, recovery inputs and compatibility with focused fixtures
tasks.summary: Complete deterministic real-temp-Git integration and adversarial fixtures covering approved LLD test strategy, run focused investigation/corpus/legacy attribution subsets and production build. Record validation evidence without claiming later-story recovery implementation.
acceptanceChecks: All ac1-ac4 proving tests and LLD unit/integration/contract subjects are mapped and pass without live providers.
Exercise foreign commits/hunks/HEAD movement, merges, intermediate revert, change kinds, path edge cases, object failures, limits, invalid artifacts and planless provenance.
Corpus helper tests and existing legacy attribution behavior stay green; no production routing change or data rewrite.
Build and validation records include exact tests/results and independent code review follows the approved workflow.

tests.name: Cross-module adversarial scope and legacy/corpus regression fixtures
